You must answer on the enclosed answer booklet.
You will need: Answer booklet (enclosed)
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
Follow the instructions on the front cover of the answer booklet. If you need additional answer paper,
ask the invigilator for a continuation booklet.
Answer one question from your chosen Depth Study.
DEPTH STUDY A: THE FIRST WORLD WAR, 1914–18
1 How important was artillery as a reason for the high casualties on the Western Front? Explain your
answer. [40]
How significant was the Kiel Mutiny as a reason for the outbreak of revolution in Germany in 1918?
Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY B: GERMANY, 1918–45
How important was Hitler to the electoral success of the Nazis by 1932? Explain your answer.
How significant was rearmament in the Nazis’ rule over Germany, 1933–39? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY C: RUSSIA, 1905–41
How important were social and economic problems in Russia in the collapse of Tsarist rule by
March 1917? Explain your answer.
How significant was collectivisation in Stalin’s rule over the Soviet Union after 1928? Explain your
answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY D: THE UNITED STATES, 1919–41
How important were new methods of production in causing the economic boom in the 1920s?
Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Roosevelt’s election campaign as a reason for his victory in the presidential
election of 1932? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY E: CHINA, c.1930–c.1990
How important were military tactics in determining the outcome of the Civil War in China? Explain
your answer.
How significant for China’s economic development were changes in agriculture in the 1950s?
Explain your answer. [40]
DEPTH STUDY F: SOUTH AFRICA, c.1940–c.1994
How important to the development of apartheid was government repression after 1948? Explain
your answer. [40]
How significant was President de Klerk in the transition to majority rule? Explain your answer.
DEPTH STUDY G: ISRAELIS AND PALESTINIANS SINCE 1945
How important were the superior resources of the Jewish armed forces as a reason for Israel’s
victory in the 1948–49 war? Explain your answer. [40]
How significant was Begin in the development of relations between Israel and its neighbours by
1996? Explain your answer. [40]
